# Contract inventory: requirement IDs → leaf gates

Built 2026-09-29 for the final acceptance review (root R9, "every contract row reconciled"). It is read-only evidence. It changes no ledger, gate or spec text.

## How it was built

**Files scanned for definitions:** `docs/spec/01-product.md` … `docs/spec/10-architecture.md`, `docs/spec/12-open-questions.md`, `docs/spec/13-revision-r2.md`, and, for `BLD-n`, `docs/spec/11-build-plan.md`. `docs/spec/README.md` defines no IDs; it only lists prefixes.

**Files scanned for gates:**
- `docs/spec/11-build-plan.md`:
  - §4, the dispatch table. Its OWNS column lists **file globs only, not requirement IDs**, so leaf coverage comes from the sources below;
  - §5, per-leaf gate text, including "r2 additions to gates";
  - §6, the node and root gate definitions;
  - §8, the rulings R-1 … R-80 and watch items W-1 … W-22.
- `docs/build/gates/leaf-*.md` (27 ledgers): gate titles and `Scope:` lines.
- `docs/build/gates/node-1.{1,2,3,4}.md`.
- `docs/build/GATES.md` (root R1–R9).
- Supporting evidence for "(by content)" mappings:
  - the named assertions and gate headers in `scripts/verify/leaf-*.mjs`, which a gate's CHECK runs;
  - the cases in `evals/agent/*.yaml`.

**ID pattern.** `(R2-)?(PRD|US|SC|DM|NUT|PLN|REC|FBK|AGT|KG|UX|ARC|OQ|BLD)-\d+`, plus the r2 section IDs `R2-(ONB|DL|MEAL|ADM|UX)`. A standalone `ADM-n`, `ONB-n`, `DL-n` or `MEAL-n` never occurs; these appear only with the `R2-` prefix.

Three kinds of token are excluded because they are not requirement IDs:
- `R-nn` (architect rulings) and `W-nn` (watch items). §8 is still applied to every row.
- `SPEC-Q-n`, `CP1`–`CP3` and gate labels.
- `KG-4.3` (13:96). It is a reference to KG-4 item 3.

**What counts as "defined".** An ID is defined where it heads a heading, a list item, a table row or a paragraph in its home file. The home files are: PRD/US/SC-1…5 → 01, DM → 02, NUT → 03, PLN → 04, REC → 05, FBK → 06, AGT → 07, KG → 08, UX → 09, ARC → 10, BLD → 11, OQ → 12, R2-*/SC-6/SC-7 → 13.

15 IDs exist only as a trailing tag on the normative sentence in their home file, with no heading or list item. That sentence is the requirement, and the ID has no other definition site. They are counted as defined and marked **(tag)** in the table: DM-1, DM-2, DM-4, DM-5, DM-7, NUT-1, NUT-5, PLN-1, PLN-3, PLN-10, REC-1, FBK-1, AGT-1, KG-1, KG-2.

An occurrence outside the home file is always a mention, never a definition (for example DM-7 at 05:13, or PLN-11 at 13:51).

**Counts.**
- **165 IDs defined**:
  - 152 in 01–10, 12 and 13. This includes 5 r2 section IDs and 9 OQs, of which 5 are decided.
  - 8 BLD IDs in 11.
- **120 mapped** to at least one gate.
- **45 unmapped**, listed in the Unmapped section at the end.
- **No ID is defined twice.** The inconsistencies found are listed under "Duplicate or inconsistent definitions" below.

**Mapping rules.**
- A gate is listed when:
  - its ledger title cites the ID **[T]**; or
  - its §5 text cites the ID **[§5]**; or
  - for node and root gates, the §6 text or the GATES.md title cites it **[§6]**/**[T]**; or
  - it clearly tests exactly that requirement, marked **(by content)** with the quoted fragment. **[V]** marks a fragment quoted from the named assertion in the gate's verify script.
- A §8 ruling that assigns a requirement to a gate is cited as, for example, "per R-40".
- "partial" means some clauses of the requirement have no gate. They are named in the notes and collected in "Partial coverage" below.
- All 27 leaf ledgers and all node gates N1–N5 are checked `[x]`.
- **Root gates R1–R9 in GATES.md are all unchecked (`EVIDENCE: pending`), and `scripts/verify/root.mjs`, which R1–R8 call, does not exist in the repo yet (R-80).** Every root mapping below is therefore marked "(pending)".

## Architect verification (R9, 2026-09-29)

The first pass was generated by a subagent from gate titles, §5/§6 text and named assertions. The architect then:
- machine-checked every gate reference: 232 of 241 are cited by the ledger title or §5 text or quote a by-content fragment; the other 9 (SC-1, SC-2, SC-5, OQ-8 to node N3; US-10; ARC-12; R2-ADM-8) are covered by §6's N3 text or the cited suites;
- rechecked every (d) item against the tests, since the first pass did not search test files: PLN-7, PLN-12 and US-4 are covered (rows updated); DM-4, REC-6 (past queueing), PLN-3 (the UI) and R2-DL-6 are untested; FBK-3's practical tags are not implemented (W-23). All five go to leaves 1.3.7 and 1.4.12 (R-82);
- ruled on the spec inconsistencies the first pass listed (R-81).

## Inventory

Definition form: H heading, L list item, P paragraph head, T table row, (tag) trailing tag.

## Duplicate or inconsistent definitions

No ID has two definition sites. These inconsistencies were found:

1. **Sat-fat default.** R2-ONB-3 (13:18) says "Default sat-fat cap = 10 % of kcal". OQ-4 (12:10, answered 2026-09-26), PLN-4 (04:55) and R-28 all say 6 %.
   - 13 claims precedence over earlier files, but the OQ-4 answer and R-28 are the later owner decision.
   - Code and gates use 6 % (leaf-1.4.4 G1 [V]).
   - 13 is not updated.
2. **SC-2 threshold.** The source texts disagree:
   - 01:78, 12 OQ-8 and R-63: median ≥ 8 %, every seed ≥ 0 %.
   - 11 §5 line 161 (1.2.3 G2): still "≥ 25 % reduction". The ledger title was updated.
   - R-62 and the `Scope:` line of `leaf-1.2.6.md`: "no seed below 5 %". R-63 superseded this.
3. **FBK-6 default gap.** 06:71 says "`min_gap_days` … (default 6)". OQ-8 and PLN-9 §6.3 (04:133) now use a day difference of ≥ 7 for main meals and ≥ 4 for snacks and workouts. R-63 SPEC-Q-6 updated the rules config, but 06 was not updated.
4. **NUT-7 carbohydrate mapping.** 03:50 maps `carbs_g` to FDC 1005. R-20 made it available carbohydrate (1005 − 1079). 03 is not amended; NUT-4 is unchanged.
5. **REC-5 follow-up trigger.** 05:97 says "if fewer than `count` dishes survive". R-67 changed it to "fewer than `count` candidates", with infeasible dishes still saved.
6. **UX-n vs R2-UX-n.**
   - Different IDs share a numeric tail. R2-UX-5 explicitly supersedes part of UX-5, and UX-5's text is not updated.
   - A plain `UX-5` search also matches inside `R2-UX-5`.
   - GATES.md labels its SC-1 gate "R2", which can be misread as the r2 prefix.
7. **Superseded in 13 but unchanged in 01–10:**
   - UX-2's "Add detail" → R2-DL.
   - UX-4 Onboarding "4 steps" and emoji → R2-ONB-1, R2-UX-5.
   - UX-4 Today's "5 food-emoji ratings" → R2-UX-4/5.
   - UX-5's emoji scale and avatars → R2-UX-5.
   - US-12 "thumbs-up/down" → R2-UX-4 stars.
   - UX-3 navigation → R-21 Q-2 (the mockups win).
   - No 01–10 ID is dropped outright.
8. **Gate numbering: §5 vs the ledgers.**
   - 1.4.3: §5 "r2 additions" names G5 inferSetup, G6 SC-6/SC-7 and G7 R2-DL. The ledger has G3 R2-DL (replacing §5's UX-2 G3), G4 inferSetup, G5 SC-6/SC-7 and G6 visual review.
   - 1.1.2: §5 G5 (fixtures) is ledger G6; ledger G5 is last-admin.
   - 1.1.3: §5 G5 (spot-check) is ledger G6; ledger G5 is R2-ONB-3 flags.
   - 1.2.4: ledger G6 has no §5 line (R-16).
9. **§6 vs what was built.**
   - §6 says root "SC-1 to SC-5" and "N5 lease releases". R-79 changed these to SC-1…SC-7 (GATES.md R2–R8) and N5 = manual review.
   - §1/§6 name `gates/root.md`; the root ledger is `docs/build/GATES.md` (R-79).
   - `scripts/verify/root.mjs` (R-80) is absent, so GATES.md R1–R8 cannot run yet.
10. **Contract scope.** §1 (11:10) defines the contract inventory as "every requirement ID in docs 01–10". The README (spec:30) lists only the prefixes PRD/DM/NUT/PLN/REC/FBK/AGT/KG/UX/ARC. US, SC, OQ, R2-* and BLD are outside both lists but carry acceptance weight (SC-1…7 are the root gates). They are included here.
11. **Default model.** AGT-2, REC-2 and ARC-9 give the default model as `claude-opus-5`. R-32 and R-44 replaced it with `DEFAULT_MODEL` (the most capable current model); the live runs used `claude-fable-5-1`.

> **Architect note (R9):** this list is the first pass. PLN-7, PLN-12 and US-4 are covered by tests (see their rows); DM-4, REC-6, PLN-3, R2-DL-6 and FBK-3's practical tags go to leaves 1.3.7 and 1.4.12 (R-82); ARC-4 and ARC-9 are R9 review items. See "Architect verification" above.

For every ID below, the following were searched: ledger gate titles and `Scope:` lines in `docs/build/gates/*.md`; 11-build-plan §5 (including r2 additions), §6 and §8; `docs/build/GATES.md`; the named assertions and gate headers in `scripts/verify/*.mjs`, both for the ID and for its key behaviour terms; and `evals/agent/*.yaml`. Where a search of the tests found an implementation or an incidental test, it is noted.

Classes: (a) covered under a different ID; (b) out of scope per 01 §5; (c) documentation only (principle, process or undecided question); (d) genuinely untested.

**No ID falls in class (b).** None of them is on 01 §5's out-of-scope list: shopping, pantry, prep scheduling, cost, waste, off-plan logging, wearables, public sharing.
